body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> Cresyn(www.cresyn.com), a Korean head/ear phone manufacturer, unveiled its premium brand ‘Phiaton’ at CES 2008, to penetrate global market.
During the exhibition, the company presented 4 headphones, 1 earphone and 1 docking station under the Phiaton brand.

‘PS 300 MC’, a headphone featuring crocodile leather design, adopted noise cancelling technology to deliver powerful bass sound and a wide frequency range, and the noise cancelling function could be continued up to 20 hours through its builit-in lithium polymer battery.
Another headphone model, ‘MS 300/400’, boasts its sensitive red color design. ‘MS 600’, the iPod docking station, is compact with opulent color and Euro-style design and delivers powerful sound.

“Just like Toyota’s success in global market through its premium brand Lexus, Cresyn launched Phiaton brand featuring advanced quality and distinctive design to compete with other global premium brand such as Boss, Sennheiser and Shure,” the company said.
